cards.title: Act Like You Belong
cards.instruction: You do not understand what is happening. Copy the confidence around you and never admit confusion.

cards.title: Believe This with Me
cards.instruction: Recruit someone into treating your impossible explanation as the most useful version of events.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Naturally. The usual arrangement. The office kettle's on strike. Help me negotiate before the clients arrive.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: I've filled it twice. It still won't boil.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Exactly how we always do it. Then water isn't its grievance. Tell it we'll stop leaving it alone after meetings.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: I can take it into the meeting.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Yes. Give it my chair. A seat at the table should get us tea.

mechanism: A copies a stop signal as strike negotiation and recruits B to treat kettle failure as a grievance best solved by inclusion.
confusable: D151 useful impossible account; D145 normalizes odd hosting without explanatory recruitment.
comparison: Physical building migration versus labor relations with appliance.
seedUse: Preserve B taking kettle to meeting as genuine helpful next move.
